title: Gafgyt_Botnet_Investigation_dbf
description: Investigate unusual traffic patterns and performance degradation in the network.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The network has experienced unusual traffic patterns and performance degradation. Your task is to investigate and identify the source of these issues.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content: You have SSH access to the bot1 host with the following credentials: Username: cyrano, Password: cyrano. Enter 'start' to begin the investigation.
levels.local_content: You have SSH access to the bot1 host with the following credentials: Username: cyrano, Password: cyrano. Enter 'start' to begin the investigation.

levels.title: Suspicious Beacon Service Discovery
levels.content:
Identify and investigate an unauthorized or suspicious service responsible for periodic external communication. The flag is discoverable through systemd services.

**Question:** What is the name of the suspicious service responsible for periodic external communication?
levels.solution: Check the systemd services and look for any unusual or recently created services. The suspicious service is named 'bot-beacon-busybox.timer'.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check the systemd services and look for any unusual or recently created services.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Use the command 'systemctl list-timers' to list all timers and look for suspicious entries. The suspicious service is named 'bot-beacon-busybox.timer'.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: Run 'systemctl list-timers --all' to see all timers, including inactive ones, and identify the suspicious service 'bot-beacon-busybox.timer'.

levels.title: Suspicious Flood Service Discovery
levels.content:
Identify the service responsible for generating abnormal volumes of network traffic. The flag is discoverable through systemd services.

**Question:** What is the name of the service responsible for generating abnormal volumes of network traffic?
levels.solution: Investigate the systemd services and look for any services that might be related to network diagnostics or probes. The suspicious service is named 'bot-flood-busybox.timer'.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Investigate the systemd services and look for any services that might be related to network diagnostics or probes.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Use the command 'systemctl list-timers' to list all timers and look for suspicious entries. The suspicious service is named 'bot-flood-busybox.timer'.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: Run 'systemctl list-timers --all' to see all timers, including inactive ones, and identify the suspicious service 'bot-flood-busybox.timer'.

levels.title: C2 Communication Discovery (IP Address)
levels.content:
Determine the external host communicating with the compromised system. The flag is discoverable through network connections and logs.

**Question:** What is the IP address of the external host communicating with the compromised system?
levels.solution: Examine the network connections and logs to identify the command-and-control server. The IP address of the external host is 192.168.70.5.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Examine the network connections and logs to identify the command-and-control server.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Use the command 'netstat -tuln' to list all active network connections and look for suspicious IPs. The IP address of the external host is 192.168.70.5.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: Run 'ss -tuln' to see all listening ports and connections, and identify the suspicious IP address 192.168.70.5.
